node.title: Contribución y reconocimiento
node.summary: A capability's operational contribution and its organisational recognition can diverge.

relations: A useful capability-loss study must include retirements that genuinely remove redundancy as well as those that destroy value.
No toda aplicación local es un diamante ni toda centralización destruye valor. El protocolo requiere definición independiente de capacidad y resultado.
The transfer-compensation example shows why network value may require funding the contributing node even when its local ledger understates the benefit it creates elsewhere.
La analogía no verifica cifras históricas del fondo ni prueba que toda línea deficitaria cree valor neto para la red.
One testable link is whether the visible model receives resources and credit while the less visible capabilities on which it depends remain under-attributed.
No se infiere intención de apropiación a partir de una narrativa atractiva; se necesitan registros de contribución y atribución.
The attribution protocol could help distinguish symbolic prestige from the budget, ownership and decision rights needed to keep an exploratory capability operational.
Aplicación propuesta; el protocolo no se ha validado aquí para comunidades de frontera ni se asignan puntuaciones a personas.
Narrative compression is one possible visibility mechanism to examine when contribution and attribution diverge; it should be traced through actual resource and authority decisions.
No toda omisión editorial es captura de valor. Se propone un mecanismo posible, no una acusación sobre actores concretos.
The second-order HID programme can extend the incentive question by testing how contribution recognition and withdrawal rights change feasible collective outcomes.
HID2-01…10 están propuestos y no ejecutados; un toy algebraico no demuestra aceleración económica real.
Authentic provenance, permission to use and contribution credit are different propositions; evidence for one should not silently decide the others.
La comparación no constituye una decisión de copyright, royalties o titularidad en un caso real.
A later economic question is whether correcting attribution changes effective withdrawal and allocation rights, rather than only symbolic credit.
El programa es propuesto; no aporta estimaciones causales sobre empresas reales.
Contribution measurement should separate the reference outcome, the evaluated decision process and the credit assigned, rather than feeding the desired verdict into the measurement.
Traslado metodológico; el cálculo del toy no acredita validez de un instrumento de atribución humana.
Attribution measures should preserve their separate dimensions; improvement in one coordinate does not automatically compensate for an unmeasured or worsening coordinate elsewhere.
La nota es correctiva y no canónica; no se impone una función universal de bienestar o valoración empresarial.
